title: Torque Wrench Zero and Calibration Check
text: Zero the torque wrench on the calibration stand before your first reading of the shift. If the needle does not return to zero within one graduation, tag the wrench out of service and swap it at the tool crib — do not adjust it yourself.

title: Frame Handling and PPE Reminder
text: Wear cut-resistant gloves whenever you handle an unpainted frame — the tube edges at the head tube and bottom bracket shell stay sharp until deburred. Support the frame at the bottom bracket shell, never by the derailleur hanger; the hanger bends under a fraction of the frame’s weight.

title: Material Handling Advisory
